premises: A DLC overlayer can be deposited on FeMnNiGeSi films via ALD with high thermal conductivity and chemical inertness.
The DLC overlayer enhances cross-plane thermal coupling and reduces thermal lag during magnetic cooling cycles.
Reduced thermal lag lowers magnetic hysteresis and sharpens the magnetostructural transition in low-dimensional films.
The magnetocaloric response in bulk FeMnNiGeSi alloys is notable but may not persist in thin films.
